description: Canonical assignable permission catalogue and endpoint inventory. Only vendorPermissions and platformPermissions are assignable; reserved, orphaned, conflicting and unknown identifiers are non-assignable. The same JSON resource drives backend registries, Flyway catalogue constraints, frontend checks and traceability tests.

conflictingPermissions.reason: SRS §11.2 names an external-confirm permission, while the implemented POS API records an external tender attempt with POS_TENDER_EXTERNAL_RECORD and requires separate POS_TENDER_MANUAL_VERIFY for review. These operations are not semantically interchangeable. Kept non-assignable pending RC-06 product/security clarification.

approvedPermissionRefinements.rationale: Dedicated authority for tenant-owned product promotion updates; it does not grant general product or price updates.
Fine-grained platform-only authority for global technical configuration; this operation is expressly in platform feature scope but has no enumerated ID in SRS/HLD §11.2.
Fine-grained platform-only authority for platform identity administration and audited MFA lifecycle; no dedicated ID is enumerated in SRS/HLD §11.2.
Separate permission for the SRS-approved tenant reactivation lifecycle transition; it is not a generic update grant.
Read-only tenant directory permission required to inspect tenant lifecycle state without granting lifecycle mutation.
Branch/register/cashier scoped report view for cashier sales; narrower than general vendor REPORT_VIEW.
Separate approval authority for promotion/discount approval; not implied by applying a discount.
Narrow authority to record the cash leg of an approved POS refund; does not grant refund approval.
Separate document-copy action for an existing POS refund.
Read-only POS refund queue/history permission distinct from refund approval and cash recording.
POS-scoped export authority; distinct from viewing POS reports and from generic report exports.
Supervisor approval for POS-originated returns; distinct from creating a return request.
Read-only audit history for an individual POS return; scoped to that tenant-owned return.
Inspects returned POS items and validates their state before receipt/approval.
Read-only queue/detail permission for POS-originated returns, separate from generic online-order returns.
Branch/register POS configuration permission; it does not grant general tenant profile management.
Records a provider/terminal tender attempt and reference only; recording is not proof of payment confirmation.
Separate supervisor review of external tender evidence; it cannot be conflated with cashier tender-attempt recording.
